title: Documenting a civic software project
abstract: This fictional methods note outlines how a team could document a civic software project. It uses a decision log, a reproducible build description and a record of open questions to illustrate the structure of a journal abstract.

title: Reading a public dataset together
abstract: This fictional reading note starts with a question about a public dataset: can two readers trace a published figure back to its source? It sketches a discussion around provenance, units and missing values.
